title: A diabolo-shaped Dy9 cluster: synthesis, crystal structure and magnetic properties

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: [Dy9L8(μ3-OH)8(μ4-OH)2(CH3OH)8](OH)(CH3OH)3 (L = 2-((1-hydroxybutan-2-ylimino)methyl)phenolate; CCDC cation C96H146Dy9N8O34 with 3 MeOH and OH-; EA calcd as C101H160Dy9N8O41)

material_class.structural_family: diabolo-shaped Dy9 formed by two square-pyramidal pentanuclear units joined through the shared apical Dy

synthesis.procedure: Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.2 mmol) and H2L (0.2 mmol) were dissolved in 15 mL methanol/dichloromethane (1:2 v/v) and stirred for 40 min. Et3N (0.6 mmol) was added and the mixture was stirred for 3 h. The yellow solution was left for slow solvent evaporation, giving yellow block crystals after 5 days.
synthesis.time: 40 min, then 3 h stirring; crystals after 5 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow solution left unperturbed; yellow block single crystals formed by slow evaporation after 5 days.

properties.summary: χMT is 124.0 cm3 K mol-1 at 300 K (slightly below 127.5 cm3 K mol-1 expected for nine free DyIII ions) and falls to 59.7 cm3 K mol-1 at 2 K, mainly from depopulation of Stark sublevels. Magnetization reaches 38.5 μB at 1.9 K and 5 T without saturation, and M vs H/T curves do not superimpose. Zero-dc-field ac susceptibility shows no out-of-phase signal, unlike a related Dy5 square pyramid.

source_locations.location: Results and discussion; Table 2 empirical formula; Experimental preparation
